title: Wall Street rallies, Dow ends with record on US-Iran deal
title_zh: 华尔街反弹，道指收盘，美伊协议创历史新高
summary: STORY: Wall Street's main indexes rallied on Monday, with the Dow gaining nearly 1% to notch a record-high close, the S&P 500 climbing about one-and-two-thirds percent and the Nasdaq soaring 3%.Investors cheered the news of a preliminary deal between the U.S.
summary_zh: 故事：华尔街主要股指周一上涨，道琼斯指数上涨近 1%，创下历史收盘新高，标准普尔 500 指数上涨约三分之二，纳斯达克指数飙升 3%。投资者对美国与美国达成初步协议的消息欢呼雀跃。

title: How SpaceX's IPO made millions for JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, & other big banks
title_zh: SpaceX 的 IPO 如何为摩根大通、高盛和其他大银行赚取数百万美元
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter David Hollerith explains how SpaceX's (SPCX) initial public offering (IPO) is fueling Morgan Stanley (MS), Goldman Sachs (GS), JPMorgan (JPM), Bank of America (BAC), and Citi (C).
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级记者 David Hollerith 解释了 SpaceX (SPCX) 首次公开募股 (IPO) 如何推动摩根士丹利 (MS)、高盛 (GS)、摩根大通 (JPM)、美国银行 (BAC) 和花旗 (C)。

title: SpaceX stock gains: What its IPO signals about its future success
title_zh: SpaceX 股价上涨：其 IPO 预示着其未来的成功
summary: SpaceX stock (SPCX) continues rising in Monday's pre-market trading (maintaining gains at the session open at the time of this video's posting) ahead of the space company's first full day of trading since its historic IPO last Friday.
